description: Editor configuration example with process resource limits
comment: This configuration should be part of the editor's main config file

lsp_server.description: Resource limits for LSP (Language Server Protocol) servers
lsp_server.comment: memory_percent: Percentage of total system memory (0-100)
lsp_server.comment2: cpu_percent: Percentage of total CPU capacity (0-100+, can exceed 100 for multi-core)

default.description: Default resource limits for other processes

notes: On Linux, this uses cgroups v2 for resource control
On non-Linux platforms, resource limiting is not yet implemented (TODO)
This configuration should be integrated into the editor's main config file
- 50% on a system with 16GB RAM = 8GB limit per process
- 200% means 2 full cores on a multi-core system
